instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the word. <break time='500ms'/> Secret.

feedback.end: Sometimes, people want their choice in a vote to be secret.

atoms.word: s e c r e t

instruction.text: How does voting secretly usually work? Listen and select the correct answer.

b.sound: Voters make their choice on paper. All pieces of paper are then collected in a box and counted. Since the name of the voter is not on the paper, it is secret.
Every voter makes a paper plane and lets it fly to the people counting the votes. Since nobody knows who threw which plane, the vote is secret.

instruction.text: Sort the three steps of voting secretly, with the first at the top.

hint.text: Select each image to hear what is happening.

feedback.finish: Many political votes are secret. During a general election, nobody has to say who they voted for.

atoms.sound: First, the voter looks at the choices on the paper and marks what they decide on.
During the second step, the voters put the piece of paper into a box.
Finally, the votes from the box are counted, and a winning option is found.
